name: activitypub
label: ActivityPub / ActivityStreams 2.0
description: W3C federated social networking standard — Mastodon, Lemmy, PeerTube, Pixelfed

table_notes.ap_actor: Represents any ActivityPub actor (Person, Group, Service, Application, Organization). Local and remote actors share this table; is_local distinguishes origin.
table_notes.ap_object: Stores ActivityStreams objects (Note, Article, Image, Video, Event, etc.) that actors create, like, or share. JSONB columns hold structured AP metadata.
table_notes.ap_activity: Records every ActivityPub activity (Create, Like, Announce, Delete, Update, Undo) as an append-only log linking an actor to the object they acted on.
table_notes.ap_follow: Tracks directed follow relationships between actors. State column reflects the follow lifecycle: pending, accepted, or rejected.

ap_actor.name: id
ap_actor.description: Internal surrogate key for the actor

ap_actor.name: actor_url
ap_actor.description: Globally unique ActivityPub actor IRI (e.g. https://mastodon.social/users/alice)

ap_actor.name: type
ap_actor.description: ActivityStreams actor type: Person, Group, Organization, Service, or Application

ap_actor.name: preferred_username
ap_actor.description: Short username used in mentions (e.g. alice in @alice@example.com)

ap_actor.name: name
ap_actor.description: Display name shown in UI (may differ from preferred_username)

ap_actor.name: summary
ap_actor.description: HTML bio/profile description provided by the actor

ap_actor.name: inbox_url
ap_actor.description: ActivityPub inbox endpoint where activities addressed to this actor are delivered

ap_actor.name: outbox_url
ap_actor.description: ActivityPub outbox endpoint listing activities this actor has published

ap_actor.name: followers_url
ap_actor.description: ActivityPub collection endpoint listing actors that follow this actor

ap_actor.name: following_url
ap_actor.description: ActivityPub collection endpoint listing actors this actor follows

ap_actor.name: public_key_pem
ap_actor.description: RSA public key in PEM format used to verify HTTP Signatures from this actor

ap_actor.name: icon_url
ap_actor.description: URL of the actor's avatar/profile image

ap_actor.name: header_url
ap_actor.description: URL of the actor's profile header/banner image

ap_actor.name: shared_inbox_url
ap_actor.description: Shared inbox endpoint for the actor's server; used for efficient fan-out delivery

ap_actor.name: is_local
ap_actor.description: True if this actor is hosted on the local server; false for federated remote actors

ap_actor.name: is_bot
ap_actor.description: True if this actor is an automated bot rather than a human user

ap_actor.name: follower_count
ap_actor.description: Cached count of actors following this actor (denormalized for query performance)

ap_actor.name: following_count
ap_actor.description: Cached count of actors this actor follows (denormalized for query performance)

ap_actor.name: created_at
ap_actor.description: Timestamp when this actor record was first stored locally

ap_object.name: id
ap_object.description: Internal surrogate key for the object

ap_object.name: object_url
ap_object.description: Globally unique ActivityPub object IRI identifying this content across the Fediverse

ap_object.name: type
ap_object.description: ActivityStreams object type: Note, Article, Image, Video, Event, Question, etc.

ap_object.name: attributed_to_id
ap_object.description: References ap_actor.id — the actor who authored or owns this object

ap_object.name: content
ap_object.description: Primary content body in HTML (the rendered post or article text)

ap_object.name: summary
ap_object.description: Content warning or subject line shown before expanding sensitive content

ap_object.name: in_reply_to_url
ap_object.description: ActivityPub IRI of the object this is a reply to; NULL for top-level posts

ap_object.name: conversation_url
ap_object.description: IRI of the thread/conversation root, used to group replies together

ap_object.name: attachments
ap_object.description: Array of ActivityStreams Document/Image objects describing media attachments

ap_object.name: to_recipients
ap_object.description: Array of actor IRIs or collection URLs in the 'to' (public/direct) addressing field

ap_object.name: cc_recipients
ap_object.description: Array of actor IRIs or collection URLs in the 'cc' (followers/mentioned) addressing field

ap_object.name: sensitive
ap_object.description: True if the content is marked sensitive/NSFW and should be hidden behind a warning

ap_object.name: lang_code
ap_object.description: BCP 47 language tag for the primary content language (e.g. en, fr, zh-TW)

ap_object.name: published_at
ap_object.description: Timestamp when the object was originally published by its author

ap_object.name: likes_count
ap_object.description: Cached count of Like activities targeting this object

ap_object.name: replies_count
ap_object.description: Cached count of objects that have in_reply_to_url pointing to this object

ap_object.name: shares_count
ap_object.description: Cached count of Announce (boost/reblog) activities targeting this object

ap_activity.name: id
ap_activity.description: Internal surrogate key for the activity record

ap_activity.name: activity_url
ap_activity.description: Globally unique ActivityPub activity IRI identifying this event across the Fediverse

ap_activity.name: type
ap_activity.description: ActivityStreams activity type: Create, Like, Announce, Follow, Delete, Update, Undo, etc.

ap_activity.name: actor_id
ap_activity.description: References ap_actor.id — the actor who performed this activity

ap_activity.name: object_id
ap_activity.description: References ap_object.id — the object this activity was performed on (NULL for Follow)

ap_activity.name: target_url
ap_activity.description: Optional ActivityPub IRI of the target collection or actor (used in Add, Move activities)

ap_activity.name: published_at
ap_activity.description: Timestamp when this activity was received or generated

ap_follow.name: id
ap_follow.description: Internal surrogate key for the follow relationship

ap_follow.name: follower_id
ap_follow.description: References ap_actor.id — the actor initiating the follow

ap_follow.name: following_id
ap_follow.description: References ap_actor.id — the actor being followed

ap_follow.name: state
ap_follow.description: Follow lifecycle state: pending (awaiting Accept), accepted, or rejected

ap_follow.name: created_at
ap_follow.description: Timestamp when the Follow activity was received and this record created

short_description: W3C federated social networking standard — Mastodon, Lemmy, PeerTube, Pixelfed
long_description: ActivityPub 1.0 is the W3C standard protocol for federated social networking, enabling decentralized social applications to interoperate. The schema covers actor profiles (people, organizations, bots), content objects (posts, articles, notes, images), activity records (Create, Like, Announce/boost, Follow), and follower relationships — the complete ActivityStreams 2.0 vocabulary.
when_to_use: Use for federated social platforms, community discussion tools, or any social application that wants to be part of the Fediverse (Mastodon, Lemmy, PeerTube, Pixelfed ecosystem). ActivityPub implementations are growing rapidly following Twitter/X changes. Required for EU Digital Services Act compliance for large platforms needing interoperability APIs under consideration.
